description: The Institute of Chartered Accounting of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995, Publication Under Section 4(2)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes accounting standards changes adopted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It contains detailed regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for financial reporting, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it establishes mandatory accounting standards and regulatory requirements rather than dealing with government structure, personnel, or other specialized categories.
